dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit sharp, high-contrast transitions from dark perimeters to lighter, desaturated interiors. The geometry of the most prominent rings is characterized by jagged, non-uniform edges with pixel-level interruptions in the dark circular boundaries.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid, low-intensity (dark) pixel clusters lacking internal gradients. These blobs are primarily located in the posterior-lateral and ventral margins, appearing as asymmetrical solid shapes interspersed between the larger macro-annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three largest central macro-annuli form an obtuse triangle. An additional four smaller annuli in the mid-dorsal region form a loose trapezoidal geometric relationship relative to the spine's curvature.

other_distinctive_markers: A dense, high-frequency reticulated pattern is visible on the anterior/neck region where the macro-annuli merge into a continuous mesh-like texture, differing from the discrete spacing seen on the main torso.
